description: Set the brands the user follows in Sightglass. companyIds replaces the whole list, so read the current one with sightglass_list_saved (kind=following) and include the ones to keep. Followed brands feed the user's home view and offer calendar. For multi-step competitor research, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

companyIds.description: The full list of company ids to follow; it replaces the current list, so include the ones to keep.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_follow_companies
title: Follow brands
